prompt:
The attached images show the official Fujikin sturgeon mascot and a chibi version of it. Redraw the chibi version with ONE CRITICAL CORRECTION.

*** THE CHARACTER MUST HAVE NO LEGS AND NO FEET. IT IS A FISH. ***
Remove every leg, foot, toe and standing nub completely. The ONLY appendages allowed are fins:
- two pectoral fins on the sides, used expressively like little arms
- one dorsal fin on the back
- a crescent tail fin
- optionally a small soft pelvic fin underneath
The underside of the body is a smooth continuous rounded fish belly with NOTHING protruding downward. Do not give it anything it could stand on.

KEEP EVERYTHING ELSE IDENTICAL to the chibi reference: polished chrome-silver body with a pale silver belly, long flat pointed snout, four barbel whiskers under the snout, a row of rounded scute bumps along the back, one large glossy black eye with a bright white catchlight, bold dark navy outline, flat cel shading with crisp white specular highlights, cheerful friendly smile.

Pure white background, full body, centred, no text, no logo.

POSE: floating and swimming happily in mid-air, body angled slightly upward, tail curving behind, both pectoral fins raised in a cheerful greeting. Weightless and buoyant, clearly a fish in water. No ground, no shadow beneath it.
